**Manager, Field Reporting**

  
  

**Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients**

  
  

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas – Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lie within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

  
  

**What you will do**

Reporting strategy and roadmap: Lead the design, development, and continuous improvement of field reporting products that support commercial execution, coaching, and leadership decisions. Translate business priorities into a clear delivery roadmap, milestones, and measurable outcomes.

Requirements and solution design: Own discovery with US business stakeholders and partner teams. Convert complex needs into functional requirements, KPI definitions, user journeys, data specifications, and scalable technical designs.

Dashboard and application development: Oversee and contribute to interactive dashboards and reporting applications using Tableau, Power BI, and React-based user interfaces. Ensure products are intuitive, reliable, accessible, and suited to field and leadership users.

React development: Guide development of reusable React components and reporting experiences. Review implementation patterns, API integrations, state management, performance, and code quality; partner with engineering teams to resolve technical issues and support maintainable releases.

Data architecture and integration: Guide data transformations, reporting layers, data models, and refresh automation. Partner with data engineering and data management teams to ensure fit-for-purpose data flows, dependable refreshes, and clear lineage.

Quality, governance, and performance: Establish standards for KPI governance, data validation, testing, release readiness, documentation, security, and access controls. Monitor report performance and data quality, resolve escalations, and drive durable corrective actions.

Operational excellence: Own support workflows, service levels, and issue-resolution processes for field reporting. Identify opportunities to automate, standardize, and simplify reporting operations, and communicate material risks and delivery status to stakeholders.

Cross-functional partnership: Build effective working relationships with Field Excellence, Data Management, Data Strategy, Incentive Compensation, Field Operations, Commercial Analytics, IT, and US business partners. Align dependencies and decisions across teams.

Team leadership and development: Manage and develop a team of reporting professionals. Set priorities, allocate work, coach team members, provide timely feedback, support career development, and create a collaborative environment focused on quality and accountability.

Delivery and stakeholder management: Lead planning and execution across concurrent initiatives, balance capacity against business priorities, and present recommendations, progress, and trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

Adoption and enablement: Oversee user training, documentation, communications, and feedback loops to increase adoption and continuously improve reporting products and processes.

**Basic Qualifications**

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline and 6+ years of relevant experience in field reporting, data management, or reporting solution development.

**Preferred Qualifications**

People leadership: Experience leading, coaching, or developing a team and coordinating delivery across multiple workstreams.

Reporting and analytics: Demonstrated experience delivering commercial or field reporting solutions using Tableau, Power BI, or comparable BI platforms.

React and web technologies: Hands-on experience developing or maintaining React applications, with JavaScript or TypeScript, reusable components, API integration, and responsive user interface practices.

Data and engineering: Strong understanding of SQL, ETL processes, data modeling, data quality controls, and cloud-based analytics environments.

Commercial domain: Experience with pharmaceutical or biotech sales and activity reporting, incentive compensation, field operations, and systems such as Veeva CRM or Salesforce.

Pharmaceutical data: Familiarity with IQVIA/IMS DDD, Xponent, PlanTrack, managed markets, or chargeback data.

Communication and partnership: Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate technical concepts and recommendations to senior leaders, business partners, and field teams.

Product quality: Experience with user experience design, accessibility, software testing, release management, and ongoing product support.

**What you can expect from us**

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers competitive and comprehensive Total Rewards Plans that are aligned with local industry standards.

  

**and make a lasting impact with the Amgen team.**

As an organization dedicated to improving the quality of life for people around the world, Amgen fosters an inclusive environment of diverse, ethical, committed and highly accomplished people who respect each other and live the Amgen values to continue advancing science to serve patients. Together, we compete in the fight against serious disease.

title: AM Public-Hyderabad-Vice President-Software Engineering
description:
**What We Do**

At Goldman Sachs, we connect people, capital and ideas to help solve problems for our clients. We are a leading global financial services firm providing investment banking, securities and investment management services to a substantial and diversified client base that includes corporations, financial institutions, governments and individuals.

**Who are we**

Goldman Sachs Engineers are innovators and problem-solvers, building solutions in risk management, big data, mobile and more. We look for creative collaborators who evolve, adapt to change and thrive in a fast-paced global environment. The Digital Client Experience teams in Asset Management provide clients with innovative and customer-centered financial products to drive transformative changes. We bring the best qualities of a technology player and combine that with the best attributes of a large bank. Our Digital teams comprise of three main businesses, underpinned by engineering, product operations, security and risk management:

* **Mosaic**, an end-to-end open architecture technology platform and a digital product that provides trading, settlement, analytics, and reporting solutions to global liquidity clients.

* **GSAM.com**: GSAM is the asset management arm of Goldman Sachs, which supervises more than $1.8 trillion in assets. Goldman Sachs Asset Management has been providing discretionary investment advisory services since 1988 and has investment professionals in all major financial centers around the world.

Our team of engineers builds solutions to the most complex problems. We develop cutting-edge digital platform and processes that form the core of our key business and enable several marketing and sales. We develop global web and mobile platform for Third Party Distribution and Institutional businesses. Team members have the opportunity to work at the forefront of technology innovation alongside industry leaders and make significant contributions to the field.

* **Advisor Portal** : An external Advisor Portal is a key component of SMA expansion program. The aim of this portal is to provide an all-digital, best in class experience to Advisors such as advisor onboarding, application for new SMAs, track accounts status, access advisor tools etc. Retail distribution requires scaling our client onboarding and portfolio management to support tens of thousands of clients through diligence, onboarding, and ongoing lifecycle events.

Join us on our journey to deliver financial products and platforms that prioritize the customer and developer experience.

**Digital Client Experience Engineering**

Digital Client Experience Engineering teams build transformative cutting-edge digital platform and processes that form the core of our key business across liquidity, marketing and sales. Our growth is driven by a relentless focus on our people, our clients and customers, and leading-edge technology, data and design principals.

As an engineer on the Digital Client Experience team, you will have the opportunity to work at the forefront of technology innovation alongside industry leaders and make significant contributions to the field. You will be one the main drivers helping evolve our product strategy as we continue to ensure we are a market leader. This will involve you being asked to come up with creative and commercial solutions to the various problems the team is tackling, and also for us to be able to lean on your leadership when executing those choices.

We are looking for engineers who can drive a whole feature from design to execution, as well as engineers who can deep dive why an API is taking half a second longer than it should. Our team has a large variety of problems to tackle across the entire stack.

**Responsibilities**

As a full stack developer you will

* Drive the design of critical components in the technology stack as well as oversee the implementation of new features, focusing on code quality, automation and testability.
* Collaborate with a global cross functional team in building customer-centric products
* Contribute to the vision, understand our product roadmap and contribute to building an engineering culture within our global team.
* Design flows and systems using cloud and on-prem technologies to ensure performance, longevity, and scalability of infrastructure.
* Contribute to SDLC documentation and guidance including templates, patterns, and controls.
* Perform code reviews and system design reviews and establish code quality standards and software best practices for a distributed systems architecture.
* Mentor and help develop more junior technical talents.
* Communicate with leadership, engineers, and business teams.

We are looking for someone with lots of energy that enjoys engineering challenges and has a passion to deliver high quality technology solutions and is able to operate in a highly fluid, rapidly changing environment.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 12 yrs of work experience.
* Experience with Java, JavaScript, and Spring Boot
* Bachelor’s degree (U.S. or foreign equivalent) in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Experience with design and implementation of low latency, high throughput, and fault-tolerant distributed systems.
* Experience with microservices architecture and API development.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Culture of excellence and collaboration
* Comfort with Agile operating models
* Energetic, self-directed, and self-motivated

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands on experience with Java and experience with any of the Rx\* variants
* Experience with Kafka or similar messaging technologies
* Experience with microservice architectures
* Experience with the Spring framework family
* Strong proficiency in: Distributed systems, Low-latency services, NoSQL and relational databases
* Experience with AWS
* Hands on experience with React and/or Angular
* Experience with external facing websites is a plus
* Experience working with clients / users a plus
* Experience with Adobe Experience Manager is a plus
  

**Goldman Sachs Engineering Culture**

At Goldman Sachs, our Engineers don’t just make things – we make things possible. Change the world by connecting people and capital with ideas. Solve the most challenging and pressing engineering problems for our clients. Join our engineering teams that build massively scalable software and systems, architect low latency infrastructure solutions, proactively guard against cyber threats, and leverage machine learning alongside financial engineering to continuously turn data into action. Create new businesses, transform finance, and explore a world of opportunity at the speed of markets.

Engineering is at the critical center of our business, and our dynamic environment requires innovative strategic thinking and immediate, real solutions. Want to push the limit of digital possibilities? Start here!

We Offer Best-In-Class Benefits

Healthcare & Medical Insurance

We offer a wide range of health and welfare programs that vary depending on office location. These generally include medical, dental, short-term disability, long-term disability, life, accidental death, labor accident and business travel accident insurance.

Holiday & Vacation Policies

We offer competitive vacation policies based on employee level and office location. We promote time off from work to recharge by providing generous vacation entitlements and a minimum of three weeks expected vacation usage each year.

Financial Wellness & Retirement

We assist employees in saving and planning for retirement, offer financial support for higher education, and provide a number of benefits to help employees prepare for the unexpected. We offer live financial education and content on a variety of topics to address the spectrum of employees’ priorities.

Health Services

We offer a medical advocacy service for employees and family members facing critical health situations, and counseling and referral services through the Employee Assistance Program (EAP). We provide Global Medical, Security and Travel Assistance and a Workplace Ergonomics Program. We also offer state-of-the-art on-site health centers in certain offices.

Fitness

To encourage employees to live a healthy and active lifestyle, some of our offices feature on-site fitness centers. For eligible employees we typically reimburse fees paid for a fitness club membership or activity (up to a pre-approved amount).

Child Care & Family Care

We offer on-site child care centers that provide full-time and emergency back-up care, as well as mother and baby rooms and homework rooms. In every office, we provide advice and counseling services, expectant parent resources and transitional programs for parents returning from parental leave. Adoption, surrogacy, egg donation and egg retrieval stipends are also available.

Benefits at Goldman Sachs

Read more about the full suite of class-leading benefits our firm has to offer.

* Drive delivery and continuous improvement of sampling, events management, customer service, Field CRM, Field AI, and transparency-reporting capabilities.

Job description:

# Hiring: Performance Marketing Specialist / Manager

\*\*Company:\*\* Absolute Marketing Agency

\*\*Location:\*\* Hyderabad, Telangana

\*\*Experience:\*\* Minimum 2+ years of relevant hands-on experience

\*\*Department:\*\* Marketing & Growth

\*\*Reports to:\*\* Head of Marketing

## About Absolute Marketing Agency

Absolute Marketing Agency helps businesses grow through performance marketing, creative campaigns, content and digital marketing. Our team includes content creators, video editors, graphic designers, project management and business development professionals.

We are looking for an experienced Performance Marketing Specialist / Manager who can independently manage paid advertising campaigns, improve lead generation and deliver measurable results for our clients.

This is a hands-on execution role. We need someone who understands the numbers behind campaigns, takes ownership of performance and can work closely with our marketing and creative teams.

## Key Responsibilities

### 1. Paid Advertising

- Plan, set up and manage Meta Ads campaigns across Facebook and Instagram.

- Manage Google Ads campaigns, including Search and other relevant campaign types where appropriate.

- Handle campaign structure, audience targeting, budgets, bidding, placements, retargeting and optimization.

- Monitor daily spend, cost per lead, conversion rates, lead quality and return on ad spend.

- Identify underperforming campaigns and take corrective action.

- Scale campaigns that consistently deliver results while staying within approved budgets.

- Manage campaigns across multiple clients and industries simultaneously.

### 2. Lead Generation and Conversion Tracking

- Build and optimize lead generation campaigns using Meta Instant Forms, landing pages and WhatsApp where appropriate.

- Ensure leads are delivered correctly to the designated Google Sheets, CRM or other approved destinations.

- Monitor tracking and troubleshoot issues involving pixels, conversion events, GTM, GA4 and platform integrations.

- Analyze lead quality, not just lead volume or low cost per lead.

- Work with the client-facing and sales teams to understand which leads convert and use that feedback to improve campaigns.

### 3. Campaign Reporting and Analytics

- Monitor campaigns daily and maintain an accurate campaign performance tracker.

- Prepare weekly performance updates by Saturday afternoon.

- Prepare monthly client performance reports by the agreed deadlines.

- Report spend, impressions, clicks, CTR, CPC, CPL, conversion rates and ROAS where relevant.

- Explain what worked, what failed, why performance changed and what actions should follow.

- Make data-backed recommendations instead of reporting numbers without analysis.

### 4. Creative Strategy and Testing

- Develop clear advertising briefs for the creative team.

- Identify suitable hooks, messaging, offers, formats and calls to action.

- Work with designers, video editors and content creators to develop performance-focused ad creatives.

- Test different creative concepts, audiences, landing pages and offers systematically.

- Use campaign results to inform the next round of creative production.

- Maintain a structured record of tests, learnings and winning creatives.

### 5. SEO and Local SEO

- Execute keyword research, on-page SEO and local SEO tasks where assigned.

- Manage Google Business Profile updates and monitor local rankings.

- Identify technical and on-page issues and coordinate website fixes with the development team.

- Track relevant keywords, competitor activity and organic search performance.

### 6. Absolute Marketing Agency's Own Growth

- Manage approved paid campaigns for Absolute Marketing Agency.

- Support lead generation for the agency's own sales pipeline.

- Test campaign offers and creatives to attract qualified business prospects.

- Coordinate with the business development team to ensure leads are handed over properly.

### 7. Account Management and Process Discipline

- Maintain a central tracker of campaigns, budgets, results, account ownership and lead destinations.

Working alongside our other product owners, you’ll assist those teams in building, implementing, and scaling architectural designs to provide a complete view of our customers―from anonymous prospects to known customers and beyond. This strategic role will also represent life cycle management objectives across our digital production teams, ensuring we use best practices across all owned/paid channels for privacy, segmentation, and personalization.

title: Experience Centre Manager
description:
**Experience Centre Manager**

**About Bewild**

Bewild, an extension of the parent company Beforest, is a sustainable food brand catering to conscientious consumers. We pride ourselves on sourcing products from large-scale permaculture farms, ensuring a diverse range of wild and natural produce reminiscent of a forest's bounty. Our offerings span various categories, including Specialty Coffee, Native Rice Varieties, Pulses, Millets, Spices, Spreads & Condiments, Seasonal veggies and fruits. With our commitment to diversity, quality, and a loyal consumer base, Bewild is positioned to lead the charge in providing sustainable, healthy food options to the market.

The Beforest Experience Centre brings this philosophy to life as a physical space - a café, a merchandise zone showcasing Bewild's produce, and a community area for events and gatherings - as part of the Experience Centre initiative launching in November 2026.

**Learn more: https://bewild.life/**

**Job description: Experience Centre Manager**

**About the role:**

**Company:** Bewild (An extension of Beforest)  
**Location:** Jubilee Hills, Hyderabad, Telangana  
**Employment Type:** Full-time | On-site  
**Experience:** 6–10 years  
**Reporting To:** Head of Bewild  
**Compensation & Benefits:**

· Monthly compensation of ₹32,000–₹38,000, with the final offer based on experience and capability.

· Health insurance coverage of ₹5 lakh, subject to the applicable policy terms.

· Gratuity as per applicable statutory provisions.

· One complimentary beverage per shift.

· Note: Meals and accommodation are not provided.

· On-the-job training and a structured four-day induction during the first week, covering Bewild and Beforest's culture, systems, operational processes, and product knowledge.

**Work Schedule**

This is an on-ground, guest-facing role at a café that operates through the week, including weekends.

· Shift: 9 hours/day.

· One weekly off, on a weekday (not Saturday or Sunday, since these are peak café days).

· Working on a government/public holiday earns one additional day off (comp-off).

**Role Overview**

The Experience Centre Manager owns the day-to-day running of the entire Experience Centre - the café, the merchandise zone, and the community space - as a single, unified guest experience. This is a hands-on operational leadership role combining the discipline of restaurant/café management with the polish and merchandising standards of a luxury retail store.

**Key Responsibilities**

· Own end-to-end daily operations of the café, merchandise zone, and community space, ensuring smooth, consistent service across all three.

· Drive sales and manage the P&L for the centre - budgets, cost control (COGS, labour, wastage) and monthly financial reporting to leadership.

· Recruit, train, schedule, and performance-manage the on-ground team (senior baristas, junior baristas, housekeeping staff).

· Set and maintain guest-experience standards across café service, retail merchandising, and community programming, in line with Beforest's brand and storytelling.

· Manage inventory and vendor relationships — stock levels, ordering, quality checks, and wastage control.

· Maintain luxury-retail-grade visual merchandising and product display standards in the merchandise zone; train the team on product knowledge and cross-selling Bewild's range.

· Coordinate events, workshops, and programs hosted in the community space.

· Ensure compliance with food safety (FSSAI), hygiene, licensing, and health & safety protocols.

· Oversee cash handling, POS reconciliation, and daily/weekly/monthly operational reporting.

· Handle guest escalations and complaints directly and resolve them on the spot.

· Act as the primary on-ground liaison with Bewild's central operations, marketing, and supply chain teams.

· Support other departments and cross-functional teams as needed.

**Requirements**

· 6-10 years of total experience, with at least 3-4 years in a managerial/supervisory role in restaurant, café, or QSR operations, or in luxury retail store management.

· Demonstrated experience owning a P&L, managing inventory, and leading a team of 6 or more.

· Strong people-management, training, and scheduling skills.

· Comfortable with POS and inventory-management systems.

· Excellent communication skills; proficiency in English and Telugu/Hindi preferred (Hyderabad-based role).

· Graduate in any discipline; a degree/diploma in hospitality or hotel management is a plus.

· Genuine interest in food, coffee, and sustainable/regenerative agriculture is a strong plus.

· A genuine commitment to going above and beyond for every customer.

Pay: ₹32,000.00 - ₹38,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance

* Ensure to get updated with ISMS roles as assigned by the department/process heads.

title: O+O Engineering lead
description:
Unleash Your Potential at L'Oréal's Beauty Tech!
  
  
Who Are We?
  
  
For 115 years, L’Oréal, the world’s leading beauty player, has devoted itself to one thing only: fulfilling the beauty aspirations of consumers around the world.
  
  
For more than a century, L’Oréal has devoted itself solely to one business: Beauty. Present in 150 countries across five continents and with €42 billion consolidated sales, L'Oréal is the global industry leader. With 37 global beauty brands across four divisions, L’Oréal offers beauty for each covering all beauty categories and catering to all beauty desires. With the acquisition of the Australian brand Aēsop in 2023, the Group continues to expand its portfolio through targeted acquisitions as part of its drive to create the future of beauty.
  
  
Today, L’Oréal includes more than 2,000 tech professionals and is constantly growing. Beauty Tech is changing the game and leading the shift towards new consumer realities and a digital disruption. Championing Beauty Tech, we invent the beauty of the future while becoming the company of the future.
  
  
Beauty Tech is how we know our consumers intimately, augmenting their beauty journeys with unparalleled diverse and sustainable experiences. Beauty Tech equips the Group with the key assets it needs to conquer this new world, where Tech has become strategic. With this ambition, L’Oréal continues to recruit diverse, innovative, skilled and passionate minds in different tech domains such as Data, Digital, Cloud, Cyber Security, IT Architecture, DevOps, Applications and Infrastructure.
  
  
A Day in the Life of O+O Engineering lead!
  
  
We are looking for an experienced and collaborative Engineering Lead to join the L'Oréal Hyderabad Tech Hub. In this strategic role, you will act as the key technical bridge between our global O+O CTO organization in Paris and the delivery teams in Hyderabad, while animating the platform engineering teams across zones in ITH.
  
  
Your core mission will be to contribute to, roll out, and drive the adoption of existing or in-progress O+O standards, platforms, and AISDLC …
  
  
You will collaborate closely with global teams to ensure successful implementation, continuous improvement, and local alignment.
  
  
Beyond driving these rollouts, you will be a hands-on leader responsible for building, recruiting, and mentoring a high-performing team (DevOps, Developers, and Engineers) based in Hyderabad to execute this transformation at scale.
  
  
In this role, You will..
  
  
**Be responsible for the following:**  
As O+O ITH Engineering lead, you will lead the software execution layer of our Beauty Tech and Online & OmniSales ambition for the programs delivered in India Tech Hub. Your role will be to turn project visions into robust, secure, scalable applications & platforms that can be activated globally by our brands, markets, and partners. You will directly contribute to accelerating our insourcing strategy, strengthening our engineering excellence, and building sustainable systems capable of supporting omnichannel, personalized experiences with strong business impact.
  
  
You will lead the implementation of the platform engineering spirit, tooling and patterns into our ITH squads, in alignment with our Global CTO technological strategy.
  
  
**In this position your main mission will be:**  

* Engineering mission and leadership:
* Contribute to the engineering vision in line with the Group’s business and technology strategy, and lead its implementation through a distributed, multicultural organization.
* As well as to the continuous improvement, deployment, and local enforcement of standardized delivery processes, tools, and best practices across all O+O (Online + Offline) programs.
* Platform Engineering:
* Drive the adoption and scaling of the AI SDLC framework within ITH, integrating AI-driven tools and automation across software development phases in alignment with global guidelines.
* Support innovation by leveraging generative AI and machine learning capabilities provided by global platforms to accelerate delivery cycles and improve code quality.
* Deploy Group solutions for End-to-end observability & Smart Ops
* Drive the roll-out, adoption, and local improvements of existing global platforms (such as the IDP - Internal Developer Portal ) for tracking and analyzing Value Creation.
* Architecture and industrialization:
* Contribute to architecture choices and engineering standards to ensure performance, resilience, security, scalability, and maintainability in modern, distributed cloud environments.
* Be the Gatekeeper for architectural decisions & tracking in partnership with the Global CTO team
* End-to-end delivery:
* Oversee the full software development lifecycle, from design to production release, accelerating the transformation of ideas, AI use cases, and product innovations into solutions deployed at scale.
* Monitor key engineering metrics, team velocity, and delivery efficiency using standard tooling, providing transparent insights to leadership in both Hyderabad and Paris.
* Transformation through GenAI: Make GenAI a concrete lever for engineering productivity and quality by scaling development copilots, test automation, documentation assistance, assisted refactoring, and the continuous improvement of delivery practices.
* Operational excellence: Strengthen DevSecOps, SRE, CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code practices to ensure fast, safe, frequent deployments and a high level of availability for critical services.
* Culture and talent: Build a demanding engineering culture based on clarity, ownership, simplicity, and impact, while attracting, developing, and retaining technical talent as part of an insourcing and team scale-up strategy.
* Cross-functional partnership:
* Act as a strategic partner to Product, Architecture, Data, Design, and application domain teams to turn business needs into clear, well-arbitrated technical decisions that create value for brands and markets.
* Ensure seamless collaboration and alignment between local delivery execution in Hyderabad and global architectural standards defined by the O+O CTO team in Paris.

What are we looking for?
  

* Experience: 10+ years of overall experience in software engineering, with at least 3-5 years in a technical leadership or delivery management role within a matrix organization.
* Tech Skills
* Proficiency in GCP and Azure environments with ability to design & implement cloud native architectures
* Good knowledge of web development technologies & architectures (React, Vue, Node )

**Director, Product Management**

**This role is** **Office Based, Hyderabad Office**

**Director, Product Management — Learning**

**About Cornerstone:**

Cornerstone powers the future of work by helping organizations develop, engage, and grow their people. Our learning and talent platform serves thousands of organizations and millions of learners worldwide, bringing together learning experiences, skills intelligence, content, and analytics so people can build the capabilities their organizations need most. We are investing heavily in the next generation of learning — including AI-assisted, skills-based, and outcome-driven experiences — and we are looking for product leaders who can turn that ambition into products customers love.

**About the Role:**

Cornerstone is seeking a Director of Product Management to lead a core area of our Learning product line. This is a senior product leadership role that combines product vision and strategy, people leadership, and disciplined execution. You will own the strategy and roadmap for your area, lead and grow a team of product managers, and be accountable for delivering learning experiences that drive measurable adoption, learner and administrator value, and commercial impact.

You will partner across engineering, design, data science, content, customer success, services, sales, and marketing to move capabilities from customer need through discovery, launch, adoption, and outcome realization. The ideal candidate brings deep enterprise SaaS product experience, a strong track record building products that customers adopt and love, and the judgment to balance long-term platform strategy with the operational rigor required to ship. Experience with AI-native and skills-based capabilities is a strong plus — AI is an increasingly central theme across the Learning portfolio.

**In this role you will...**

**Set vision & strategy**

* Own the product vision and multi-year roadmap for your area of the Learning portfolio, grounded in market trends, customer needs, and Cornerstone's strategy.
* Make and defend prioritization decisions with clear rationale, translating strategy into a sequenced roadmap and well-formed bets.
* Frame the business case for major investments — market sizing, opportunity, and expected outcomes — and align leadership and cross-functional partners behind it.
* Champion AI and skills-based innovation where it creates real learner and administrator value, integrating intelligent capabilities responsibly into the learning experience.

**Lead & grow the team**

* Hire, coach, and develop a team of product managers, setting a high bar for product craft, customer empathy, and accountability.
* Establish product standards and operating cadences for discovery, planning, release, and outcome review across your team.
* Create clarity and alignment across product, engineering, and design leadership, and represent your area to executives and customers.

**Discover, experiment & measure**

* Drive rigorous customer discovery, engaging directly with enterprise customers, learners, and administrators to validate problems and use cases before committing to solutions.
* Run a hypothesis-driven practice — define success metrics, instrument products, and use experimentation and A/B testing to learn quickly and de-risk decisions.
* Define and own the success metrics and North Star for your area (adoption, engagement, retention, time-to-value, and business outcomes), and use them to guide investment.
* Translate customer, field, and market feedback into clear requirements, prioritized backlogs, and release plans.

**Deliver with rigor**

* Drive cross-functional delivery across product, engineering, design, data science, content, customer success, services, and go-to-market teams.
* Establish strong operating cadences for milestone reviews, dependency management, risk tracking, and outcome measurement, surfacing risks early.
* Partner with go-to-market and customer-facing teams on rollout planning, launch enablement, implementation readiness, and feedback loops.
* Ensure capabilities are scalable, secure, compliant, and practical for adoption in enterprise environments, meeting expectations for security, privacy, and data governance.

**What Success Looks Like:**

* A clear, well-communicated vision and roadmap that leadership, customers, and the team understand and rally behind.
* A high-performing product team that ships quality work on a predictable cadence and grows in capability.
    
  Products that customers adopt and love — reflected in faster time-to-value, stronger engagement and retention, anD measurable business outcomes.
* Decisions grounded in evidence from discovery, experimentation, and metrics rather than opinion alone.
* AI-assisted and skills-based capabilities launched in ways that are trusted, usable, and outcome-oriented.
* Security, compliance, and data governance requirements embedded into delivery from the start.

**You've got what it takes if you have…**

* 10+ years in product management, including experience leading product managers, in enterprise software, SaaS, or platform organizations.

* Experience delivering AI-native products, intelligent agents, copilots, automation, or workflow-based AI in enterprise settings.

title: Asia Markets News Curator
description:
**Engagement:** Full-time, remote (independent contractor)  
**Compensation:** INR 35,000/month base + performance bonus  
**Hours:** Approx. 06:00–16:00 IST, Monday to Friday  
**Reports to:** Senior Editor (direct, daily)

**About the role**

We are a Singapore-headquartered investment research firm producing macro and equity research. Together with a US partner, we are launching an Asian markets newsflow service: live, curated, real-time coverage of Asia-Pacific equities, economic and macro events, distributed to retail and professional clients.

The person we hire will be the live engine of this product. During Asia trading hours, you will scan the tape, filter the noise, and publish short, sharp, time-stamped updates that traders and portfolio managers can act on within seconds. The output is fast, factual, well-formatted newsflow with just enough context to be useful at the screen, sourced from the tools and platforms we provide.

**What you will do, every day**

*Live curation (the core of the job)*

* Monitor primary news sources across India, Japan, ASEAN (Singapore, Indonesia) and Greater China (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Shenzhen), covering listed companies and key economic and macro releases, depending on your assigned market focus.
* Publish short updates per shift in the agreed format: timestamp, ticker or instrument, one-sentence headline, and a few lines of context where it adds value.
* Prioritise what moves markets: earnings surprises, regulatory actions, central bank decisions, large block trades and sector-moving headlines. Leave out the noise.
* Cross-check newswires, exchange filings (HKEX, SGX, NSE/BSE, TSE), regulator releases (MAS, BoJ, RBI, PBoC, etc.) and reputable local-language sources, depending on the assigned region.

*Scheduled deliverables*

* **Asia Pre-Open (06:30 IST):** overnight US handover, key Asia events on the day, scheduled data and earnings.
* **Asia Midday Wrap (12:30 IST):** morning movers, sector rotation, intraday news of consequence.
* **Asia Close (15:45 IST):** index closes, top movers with attributed reasons, what to watch.

*Standards and quality control*

* The Senior Editor sets templates, examples and editorial standards. You follow them precisely, every day, without drift.
* All output is in clean, professional English, free of AI-generated phrasing, filler, marketing language and personal opinion.
* Source every non-obvious claim. Never copy text verbatim from a wire or filing; paraphrase tightly.

**Must-have requirements**

* **Markets fluency.** You already understand what a P/E, a yield curve, a credit spread, an earnings surprise and a central bank decision are, and why a trader cares. We will not teach this from scratch.
* **Asia-Pacific market knowledge.** Working familiarity with at least one of: Indian equities (Nifty, Sensex), Greater China (HSI, CSI 300, A-shares vs H-shares), Japanese equities (Nikkei, TOPIX), ASEAN equities, regional economics.
* **Professional written English.** Crisp, accurate, neutral, fast. Closer to Reuters or Bloomberg style than to retail blogging. We will test this.
* **Speed and discipline.** Comfortable publishing short updates per shift with zero careless errors. Tickers and numbers must be right every time. The work is routine by design and rewards genuine interest in markets, high standards and personal reliability.
* **Reliable infrastructure.** Stable broadband, a dedicated quiet workspace, a modern laptop, and the ability to start your shift on time every trading day.
* **Education.** Bachelor’s degree minimum, ideally in finance, economics, accounting, business or a quantitative discipline. CFA candidates or charterholders preferred but not required.
* **Tools.** Comfortable with Excel, Slack, Google Workspace and standard news-aggregation interfaces. Experience with Bloomberg, Refinitiv, FactSet or similar is a strong plus.

**Strong pluses**

* Prior experience as a sell-side or buy-side analyst, newswire reporter or trading desk assistant.
* Reading proficiency in Hindi, Mandarin, Cantonese, Bahasa Indonesia or Japanese for monitoring local-language sources.
* Practical experience using AI tools in a research or news workflow.
* Familiarity with institutional trading or market data platforms.

**What this role is not**

* Not investment advice. We never tell readers what to buy or sell. We report facts and frame context.
* Not long-form research. Your focus is newsflow and the live tape.
* Not sales. You will not pitch clients or speak with subscribers.

**Selection process**

* **Step 1: Application.** CV plus a short note (max 200 words) on which Asian markets you follow most closely and why.
* **Step 2: Written test (paid, ~2 hours).** We send you a one-hour window of raw Asia trading-hours newsflow and you produce 30 curated updates in our format. This is the single most important filter.
* **Step 3: Live trial day (paid).** A half shift producing real output, reviewed in real time by the Senior Editor.
* **Step 4: Offer and 90-day probation.** Performance reviews on days 30, 60 and 90.

**Compensation and growth**

* INR 35,000/month base, paid monthly.
* Performance bonus tied to update volume, accuracy and editor revisions.
* Annual review with a clear progression path: Curator, Senior Curator, Editor.
* All training, templates, source lists and tooling provided.

**How to apply**

Apply through Indeed with:

* CV (PDF, max 2 pages).
* Short note (max 200 words), as described in Step 1.
* One example of your own written work in English on a financial topic, such as a blog post, internship report, university paper, sample wire-style update, or anything comparable.

*We respond to every applicant within 7 days. Suitable candidates proceed directly to the written test.*

Pay: ₹35,000.00 per month

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Hyderabad, Telangana

Job Summary

Natural Power Asia Pvt. Ltd. is looking for a proactive and target-oriented Solar Channel Partner Executive to develop, onboard, and manage a network of channel partners for our solar EPC business. The candidate will be responsible for partner acquisition, business development, lead generation, sales coordination, and maintaining long-term relationships with partners to increase the company's solar project business.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Channel Partner Acquisition**

* Identify and approach potential solar channel partners across Telangana and other regions of India.
* Connect with electrical shops, solar dealers, electricians, solar installers, builders, architects, contractors, consultants, and business entrepreneurs.
* Explain the company's solar EPC services, partnership opportunities, business model, and earning potential.
* Generate leads through telephone calls, WhatsApp, social media, email, referrals, and direct meetings.
* Register new channel partners and maintain their details in the company database.

**2. Partner Onboarding and Relationship Management**

* Guide new partners through the registration and onboarding process.
* Share company profiles, product information, service details, marketing materials, and partnership guidelines.
* Maintain regular communication with existing partners and encourage them to generate business.
* Conduct follow-ups, online meetings, and partner training sessions whenever required.
* Resolve partner queries by coordinating with the concerned internal departments.

**3. Lead Management and Sales Coordination**

* Collect customer enquiries and project leads from channel partners.
* Record and track leads in Excel or the company's CRM system.
* Coordinate with the sales and technical teams for site surveys, quotations, pricing, and project feasibility.
* Follow up on quotations and ensure timely communication with partners.
* Track each lead from initial enquiry to order confirmation and project execution.

**4. Business Development and Performance Monitoring**

* Work towards monthly targets for new partner acquisition, active partners, qualified leads, and project conversions.
* Identify opportunities to expand the company's channel partner network.
* Monitor partner performance and prepare regular reports on leads, enquiries, quotations, and orders.
* Suggest strategies to improve partner engagement and business generation.

**5. Reporting and Coordination**

* Maintain an updated channel partner database with contact details, location, business type, and lead status.
* Submit daily activity reports and weekly performance reports to the reporting manager.
* Coordinate with sales, engineering, procurement, marketing, and project execution teams.
* Ensure all partner communications and commercial commitments follow company policies.

Eligibility Criteria

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Commerce, Engineering, or a related field.
* 0–3 years of experience in channel sales, business development, dealer management, or solar sales.
* Solar EPC, renewable energy, electrical products, or distributor network experience will be preferred.
* Good communication, negotiation, presentation, and follow-up skills.
* Knowledge of MS Excel, email, WhatsApp Business, and basic CRM operations.
* Ability to work with sales targets and develop long-term business relationships.
* Willingness to travel for partner meetings when required.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Number of new channel partners onboarded.
* Number of active partners generating enquiries.
* Qualified leads received from partners.
* Quotations and orders generated through the partner network.
* Revenue and project conversions from channel partners.
* Partner engagement, follow-up quality, and reporting accuracy.

Compensation and Benefits

* Monthly salary based on experience and suitability.
* Performance-based incentives linked to company-approved targets.
* Opportunities for career growth in solar channel sales and business development.

title: Engineering Director
description:
Who We Are

We are Two Circles. We are a Sports & Entertainment Marketing business. We grow audiences and revenues by knowing fans best.

We work with clients to help them understand and influence fan behaviour — how fans spend their money, the events they attend, the channels they respond to, and the content they engage with. We use this understanding to help our clients grow both direct-to-consumer and business-to-business revenues.

Our platforms and services are trusted by over 1,000 clients globally, including the English Premier League, Red Bull, UEFA, VISA, the NFL, Nike and Amazon. We are over 1,000 people, based across 15 offices worldwide, delivering work for sports and entertainment organisations of all shapes and sizes.

India is a long-term commitment for Two Circles. We're already trusted by the BCCI, one of the biggest and most important properties in world sport, and our Hyderabad office sits at the heart of that relationship. Being here, and succeeding here, is central to how we build a better future for the sports and entertainment industry globally.

Hyderabad is a Two Circles office, not a GCC. Today it's tech-centric, but our ambition is to diversify what we build here over time, growing into a broad Two Circles presence rather than staying confined to technology propositions.

What you will do

We’re looking for an Engineering Director to lead our Hyderabad delivery organisation. You’ll lead a team of around 50 engineers, QA and delivery specialists, and the team is still growing. They work across our Data and Digital Products & CRM practices and deliver for clients and colleagues around the world.

You’ll report to our APAC Managing Director, with a dotted line to our Engineering Directors for Data and for Digital Products & CRM. As the most senior Two Circles leader in our Hyderabad office, you’ll also play an important role in our work with the BCCI, our most important partner in India. The role is based in Hyderabad.

This is a leadership role first and foremost. You’ll build and run a high-performing team and set the tone for its culture. You’ll bring discipline and predictability to how we deliver and make the India team’s performance visible to the rest of the business.

You’ll bring enough fluency in engineering and software delivery to earn the respect of our team, understanding trade-offs, spotting risk, and knowing when and how deep to go. You’ll govern quality and standards within the technical direction set by our global Engineering Directors and ensure excellence in the process for how we deliver software. You won’t be expected to set that direction yourself, but you will be expected to make sure it’s executed brilliantly in India.

We want Hyderabad to be known, by 2029, not just for delivering the work, but for shaping it, owning it, and making it better. That means more ownership of outcomes, greater exposure to our clients and their problems, more leaders and careers built from within Hyderabad, and a reputation for ideas, innovation and smart use of AI, all while protecting the spirit and connection that makes Two Circles what it is as we grow. You'll be the person most accountable for getting us there.

Key responsibilitiesLeading the team and its culture

* Lead, grow and retain the India team, including recruitment, onboarding and development of new team members.
* Co-own the culture of our Hyderabad office with our HR Lead. You’ll treat culture as a core part of your job, not something handed off to the HR team. You will be the role model of Two Circles spirit in the office.
* Build an India leadership layer of Engineering Managers, QA leadership and delivery leadership. Embed progression frameworks, career pathways and regular, structured feedback.
* Be a visible, accessible leader in the office. Build strong relationships and encourage the face-to-face collaboration that builds trust and improves delivery.

Delivery and engineering excellence

* Own the software delivery lifecycle across India projects, with consistent processes that drive quality and predictability.
* Oversee QA and release management standards across India builds, aligned with our global standards.
* Stay close to the work: attend key governance forums, review delivery health weekly, and step in when projects need support.
* Work with our Tech Leads to ensure technical standards and architectural approaches are followed, in line with the direction set by our Engineering Directors for Data and Digital Products & CRM.
* Embed the agentic engineering practices being rolled out across our global teams. Drive adoption in India and share what you learn.
* Help the India team take increasing ownership of outcomes end-to-end, including design, not just execution, and reduce reliance on other regions to unblock problems.

Performance, metrics and governance

* Create and run a monthly governance process and health report for the India team. It should cover hiring, onboarding, attrition, utilisation, quality and performance, and progress on major initiatives.
* Own delivery, quality and team health metrics, including code quality, production defects and time to resolve issues. Track how the project leaders the India team works with in other regions rate its work.
* Own utilisation and cost efficiency across India delivery. Propose the India hiring plan and work with Delivery Directors globally on resource planning and hotspots.

Global collaboration

* Give leadership upward visibility, and give teams clarity on priorities, outcomes and decisions.
* Work with Directors in Melbourne, London and Vancouver to develop operating models that let teams work smoothly across regions.
* Work effectively across time zones and cultures, bringing structure and clarity to complex, global work.
* Help Hyderabad become a knowledge hub, not just a delivery team: bring in what's working well from London, Melbourne and Vancouver, and feed Hyderabad's own innovations back out to the rest of the business.

What success looks like in your first year

* A high-performing team, shown in hard metrics such as code quality, production defects and time to resolve issues and in strong feedback from the project leaders the team works with across regions.
* A strong culture in our Hyderabad office, measured against our regular pulse checks.
* Our agentic engineering practices widely adopted across the India team.
* A clear monthly view of the India team’s health, shared with the wider business through a regular governance process.
* An India leadership layer in place that can support continued growth.

  
**Requirements**  

* 15+ years’ experience, including senior leadership of an organisation of 50+ people across engineering, QA and delivery, and experience managing managers.
* Direct leadership of engineering and QA teams, ideally having started your career as an engineer. You can contribute credibly to architecture and code-quality discussions across both data engineering and digital product engineering.
* Senior client-facing experience in a services, agency or consultancy business.
* Experience working within a multi-region or global delivery model.
* Hands-on ownership of the software delivery lifecycle, delivery processes, resourcing and talent management.
* Strong emotional intelligence and resilience, and the ability to influence senior peers and stakeholders.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to lead and inspire teams and engage a wide range of internal and external stakeholders.
* An interest in AI-enabled development practices and the drive to lead their adoption.
* Eligibility to work in India.
* Able to travel regularly to Vancouver, London and Melbourne.

Nice to have

* Familiarity with the platforms we build on (CMS, identity, video, CRM and e-commerce) and modern cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure or Google Cloud.
* Familiarity with sports and entertainment.
* Experience building or leading a Global Capability Centre or an India-based global delivery hub.
* Experience in both startup-style and enterprise-scale environments.

description:

The Manager, R&D Quality provides quality assurance expertise and oversight for research and development activities, with a particular focus on oligonucleotide and xRNA analytics. The role partners with cross-functional teams to ensure compliance with applicable GxP regulations, regulatory requirements, Novartis procedures and quality standards.

### **About the Role**

**Major Accountabilities:**

* Support maintenance of the regulatory -required files for health authority inspections and assist with health authority inspection management

* Aid in the identification of quality issues and assist with root cause investigations and support the development of corrective and preventative action plans (CAPA), including monitoring status to Ensure issues are addressed, completed and documented.

As the leading bank in Asia, DBS Consumer Banking Group is in a unique position to help our customers realise their dreams and ambitions. As a market leader in the consumer banking business, DBS has a full spectrum of products and services, including deposits, investments, insurance, mortgages, credit cards and personal loans, to help our customers realise their dreams and aspirations at every life stage. Our financial solutions are not only the best in the business – they were made just

**Job Purpose**

Lead acquisition, activation, value build-up and retention of high-quality current-account relationships across an assigned cluster. The role owns the cluster’s current-account growth agenda across business segments—including traders, wholesalers, manufacturers, service professionals, institutions and emerging enterprises—while building fee income and cross-sell penetration.

The Cluster Sales Head will lead a team of current-account sales team and relationship managers, work closely with branches and product partners, and ensure the cluster delivers profitable, compliant, transaction-active current-account growth.

**Responsibilities**

**. Cluster Business Ownership**

* Deliver new-to-bank current-account acquisition, account activation, average quarterly balance growth, transaction throughput and fee-income targets for the cluster.
* Build and execute a catchment-led acquisition strategy for high-potential business segments such as wholesalers, distributors, manufacturers, traders, schools, hospitals, clinics, professional firms and service establishments.
* Translate cluster targets into branch-, team- and individual-level productivity plans.
* Own the current-account business plan, sales funnel, conversion pipeline and weekly performance rhythm.
* Improve portfolio quality by prioritising transaction-active, balance-building and cross-sell-ready relationships over dormant or low-value acquisition.

* **Sales Leadership and Channel Execution**

* Lead, coach and motivate a field-sales organisation to consistently deliver acquisition and value-build targets.
* Establish a disciplined sales cadence covering joint calls, market visits, lead reviews, branch huddles, pipeline reviews and conversion tracking.
* Ensure each relationship manager follows a profile-based sales approach rather than a generic product pitch.
* Develop market intelligence on competitor propositions, local business clusters, referral sources and emerging commercial hubs.
* Build productive referral ecosystems with Chartered Accountants, trade associations, market intermediaries, merchant networks, developers, institutional administrators and existing clients.

* **Current-Account Activation and Value Build-Up**

* Ensure newly acquired accounts become transaction-active within defined activation timelines.
* Drive operating balances, inward credits, collections, payment activity and digital banking adoption.
* Track early-warning indicators including low funding, non-activation, declining balances, low transaction velocity and potential attrition.
* Build strategies to migrate primary transaction flows—collections, vendor payments, payroll, taxes and operating cash—to the bank.
* Improve account quality by monitoring average balance, debit transactions, credit transactions and account profitability.

* **Solution-Led Cross-Sell**

* Use the current account as the primary operating hub for business clients and identify the appropriate product solution based on the customer’s business model.
* Drive adoption of corporate internet banking and mobile approvals; cash management and bulk payment solutions; POS, Android POS, QR and Soundbox; sweep-in / sweep-out or FFD structures; debit cards; collections and transaction banking solutions; and promoter, family, wealth and premium savings propositions.
* Partner with product teams to convert business pain points into integrated propositions—for example, POS for collections, Internet Banking for payment controls, FFD for temporary balances and Aspire/premium banking for promoter wallet deepening.

* **Customer Relationship and Service Governance**

* Build senior-level relationships with anchor clients and participate in strategic joint calls for high-value prospects.
* Ensure timely resolution of onboarding, account-opening, transaction, service and digital-banking issues.
* Work with branches and operations teams to reduce turnaround time, improve onboarding quality and strengthen client experience.
* Review top customers and at-risk accounts regularly to protect balances, transactions and wallet share.
* Drive customer retention through proactive engagement, problem solving and relevant product deepening.

* **Risk, Compliance and Portfolio Quality**

* Ensure all sourcing, onboarding and account activation follows internal policies and applicable KYC, AML, fraud-risk and regulatory requirements.
* Maintain high standards of customer due diligence, documentation quality, source-of-funds understanding and business-profile validation.
* Monitor exceptions, unusual transaction behaviour, documentation gaps and operational risks; escalate promptly where needed.
* Build a culture of right-first-time acquisition, with no compromise on compliance for target achievement.

* **People Leadership**

* Recruit, develop, retain and performance-manage a high-quality current-account sales team.
* Set clear scorecards covering acquisition, activation, AQB/AMB, transaction activity, fee income, cross-sell, productivity, service quality and compliance.
* Conduct structured coaching through joint market visits, call observations, weekly reviews and capability-building sessions.
* Identify skill gaps and develop targeted interventions around sales planning, segment understanding, solution selling, digital banking and compliance.
* Maintain a strong talent pipeline and manage attrition proactively.

**Experience**

* 8–15 years of relevant experience in banking, preferably in current accounts, CASA, business banking, SME banking, transaction banking, branch banking or merchant acquiring.
* At least 3–5 years in a people-leadership role managing sales managers, relationship managers or acquisition teams.
* Demonstrated track record of building a current-account portfolio, increasing operating balances and delivering cross-sell revenue.
* Experience in managing business clusters, market catchments, branch ecosystems or multi-location sales teams is preferred.

**Education**

* Graduate degree required.
* MBA / PGDM in Finance, Sales, Marketing or Banking preferred.
* Relevant certifications in banking, KYC/AML, payments or financial products are an advantage.

**Skills and Competencies**

* Strong understanding of current-account economics, CASA, transaction banking, payments, merchant acquiring and business-client needs.
* Proven ability to lead field sales, build market networks and execute through branches and partner channels.
* Solution-selling mindset with ability to connect client pain points to banking products.
* Strong command of sales analytics, funnel management, portfolio reviews and performance dashboards.
* Excellent stakeholder-management skills across branches, products, operations, risk and service.
* High integrity, sound judgement and uncompromising compliance orientation.

title: Retail Cluster Manager
description:
**About Optorium**

Optorium is Hyderabad's leading destination for luxury and premium eyewear, established in 2004 with 5 boutique stores across Banjara Hills, Gachibowli, Secunderabad, and Kukatpally. We carry the world's most prestigious eyewear brands including Gucci, Prada, Tom Ford, Ray\-Ban, Burberry, and more.

We are at an exciting growth inflection point — strong walk\-in traffic, an established brand, and a loyal customer base. We now need a driven, commercially sharp leader to take ownership of business development and marketing strategy across all four branches and deliver aggressive year\-on\-year sales growth.

"This is a P\&L accountability role. The Cluster Head owns the number — revenue targets, YoY growth, marketing ROI, and customer acquisition — across all four Optorium branches in Hyderabad."

**Role Overview**

The Cluster Head will be the senior commercial leader across Optorium's Hyderabad cluster, responsible for driving revenue growth, building and executing the marketing strategy across online and offline channels, and building the brand's dominance in the local luxury eyewear market. This person will set sales targets for each branch, monitor performance daily, lead BTL and ATL campaigns, drive digital growth, and develop new business opportunities — from corporate tie\-ups to brand events and influencer activations.

This is a high\-autonomy, high\-accountability role. You will have direct access to the founders, a budget to execute your plans, and a clear incentive structure that rewards overperformance generously.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Business Development \& Revenue Growth**

* Own the monthly and annual revenue target for all four branches — set branch\-wise sales goals in alignment with overall Optorium business targets
* Identify and develop new revenue streams — corporate gifting programmes, B2B tie\-ups with hospitals, clinics, corporates, hotels, and high\-net\-worth individual networks
* Build and manage relationships with key accounts — concierge services, premium corporate HR departments, and referral partners
* Track competitor activity (Dayal Opticals, Gem Opticians, Specsmakers) and identify market gaps or opportunities for Optorium to exploit
* Develop a structured customer retention programme — loyalty offers, repeat purchase incentives, and premium member benefits
* Identify and evaluate potential new branch locations or pop\-up opportunities for future expansion
* Prepare and present a monthly business development report to the founders with pipeline, deals, and revenue impact

**2\. Sales Target Setting, Monitoring \& Incentive Management**

* Set monthly and quarterly sales targets for each branch and each sales staff member — broken down by brand, category (frames, sunglasses, lenses), and ticket size
* Monitor daily sales performance across branches using POS data and report variances against target with corrective actions
* Design and run monthly branch\-level sales incentive schemes — aligned to the company's monthly \+ annual variable incentive structure
* Conduct weekly sales review calls with branch managers and a monthly in\-person performance review at each branch
* Build a YoY growth dashboard tracking revenue, footfall, conversion rate, average ticket size, and repeat customer ratio per branch
* Identify underperforming branches early and implement focused turnaround plans within 30 days

**3\. Marketing Strategy — Online \& Offline**

* Own the integrated marketing strategy for Optorium across all channels — digital, in\-store, events, PR, and paid media
* Work in close coordination with the Content \& Digital Marketing Executive to ensure all content, SEO, and social media output is aligned to business goals and seasonal campaigns
* Plan and execute a quarterly marketing calendar — aligned to brand launches, festive seasons (Diwali, New Year, Valentine's Day, Summer), and new collection drops
* Manage and optimise the Google Ads and Meta Ads budgets — set target CPL (cost per lead), ROAS (return on ad spend), and walk\-in attribution goals
* Develop Optorium's online presence strategy to build national visibility alongside the dominant Hyderabad local ranking
* Track and report marketing ROI monthly — spend vs. footfall lift, revenue attributed to campaigns, and channel\-wise performance

**4\. BTL (Below the Line) Marketing**

* Plan and execute hyperlocal BTL activations — in\-mall promotions, residential society events, corporate campus drives, and premium apartment complex tie\-ups near each branch
* Organise in\-store brand events — exclusive preview nights, brand ambassador visits, new collection launches, and VIP customer evenings
* Manage the annual in\-store visual merchandising refresh — window displays, POP materials, and brand\-specific display zones aligned to seasonal campaigns
* Coordinate with brand principals (Luxottica, Safilo, etc.) to access co\-branded BTL budgets and promotional materials
* Execute referral and word\-of\-mouth programmes — structured incentives for existing customers who bring new buyers
* Build a database of Hyderabad's premium residential catchments near each branch and execute targeted door\-drop or WhatsApp campaigns

**5\. ATL (Above the Line) Marketing**

* Plan and manage ATL campaigns — OOH (outdoor hoardings near each branch), radio spots on Hyderabad's premium stations, and print in curated luxury lifestyle publications
* Develop seasonal ATL campaigns for key moments — summer sunglass season, festive gifting, and New Year refresh
* Brief and manage creative agencies for campaign concept, design, and production
* Negotiate media buying — hoarding placements, radio slots, and magazine insertions — at optimal rates
* Track ATL campaign impact through footfall data, brand search volume lift, and customer\-reported discovery source

**6\. Digital \& Online Channel Growth**

* Drive Optorium's e\-commerce revenue growth through optorium.in — set monthly online sales targets and work with the digital team to optimise conversion
* Develop and execute a performance marketing strategy — Google Shopping ads, Search ads, Meta retargeting — to drive both online sales and store walk\-ins
* Oversee Optorium's local SEO strategy in coordination with the content team — targeting top\-3 Google rankings for all major brand \+ Hyderabad keyword combinations
* Build and manage influencer marketing strategy — identify, brief, and coordinate Hyderabad\-based luxury lifestyle micro and macro influencers
* Develop a WhatsApp Business strategy for customer segmentation and targeted new collection communications

**7\. Team Leadership \& Branch Management Support**

* Lead, mentor, and motivate branch managers and sales teams across all four locations
* Set clear performance expectations for each branch team and conduct quarterly performance reviews in coordination with the HR Executive
* Identify skill gaps in the sales team and plan product knowledge and upselling training sessions — minimum once per quarter
* Ensure consistent premium customer experience standards across all four branches through regular floor visits and mystery shopping
* Collaborate with the HR Executive on hiring plans to ensure branches are fully staffed ahead of peak seasons

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

YoY Revenue growth target set \& delivered every financial year100%Monthly branch\-wise sales targets set by 1st of each month4/qtr. BTL activations — minimum one per branch per quarter Top 3Google ranking for all major brand \+ Hyderabad keywords\<3%Marketing spend as % of total cluster revenue2–3New B2B / corporate accounts opened per quarter

**Skills \& Requirements**

**Must\-have**

* 5 years of experience in retail business development, area/cluster management, or marketing — luxury, lifestyle, or premium consumer goods preferred
* Proven track record of owning and delivering revenue targets across multiple locations
* Hands\-on experience planning and executing BTL and ATL campaigns end to end
* Strong understanding of digital marketing — Google Ads, Meta Ads, SEO, and performance marketing metrics
* Excellent commercial acumen — comfortable reading P\&L, footfall data, and conversion metrics
* Strong leadership skills — able to motivate, coach, and hold accountable a multi\-branch sales team
* Excellent communication in English and Telugu/Hindi — able to present confidently to founders and brand partners
* Highly organised and data\-driven — uses dashboards and reports to lead decisions, not gut alone

**Nice to have**

* Prior experience in optical, eyewear, watches, jewellery, fashion accessories, or luxury retail
* Existing network of Hyderabad corporate accounts, premium residential communities, or brand partnerships
* Experience working with international luxury brand principals (Luxottica, Safilo, LVMH, Kering)
* Knowledge of Google Search Console, SEMrush, or Meta Business Suite
* Experience managing creative agencies and media buyers
* MBA in Marketing, Sales, or Business Management
* Experience with CRM tools and customer segmentation strategies

**What We OfferCompensation**

₹40,000 starting \+ uncapped monthly incentives \+ annual YoY bonus. Total CTC at target: ₹6\.5L–₹10L\+.

**P\&L Ownership**

You own the number for all four branches. Full autonomy to plan, spend, and execute — with direct founder access for fast decisions.

**Growth Path**

As Optorium expands to new cities, this role grows into a Regional Head or VP — Sales \& Marketing position. First mover advantage for the right person.

**Brand Access**

Work with Gucci, Prada, Tom Ford, Ray\-Ban, and Burberry. Build relationships with the world's leading eyewear brand teams in India.

**Marketing Budget**

Dedicated marketing budget to execute your strategy — BTL activations, ATL campaigns, digital ads, influencer collabs, and events.

**Development**

Executive development budget — leadership programmes, marketing certifications, and luxury retail industry conferences.

Pay: From ₹40,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Life insurance
* Provident Fund

Work Location: On the road
