title: Events Platform Manager
description:
**Job Title: Events Platform Manager**

* Location: Hyderabad


About Sanofi


We are an innovative global healthcare company, committed to transforming the lives of people with immune challenges, rare diseases and blood disorders, cancers, and neurological disorders. From R\&D to sales, our talented teams work together, revolutionizing treatment, continually improving products, understanding unmet needs, and connecting communities. We chase the miracles of science every single day, pursuing Progress to make a real impact on millions of patients around the world.


Sanofi has currently the best and most robust pipeline of R\&D and consequent new launches in our history. The Go\-to\-Market Capabilities Team was organized to consolidate business operations efforts globally across all business units with an eye to create efficiencies that fund our pipeline and prepare us to drive multiple new product launches as we strive to materialize the miracles of science to improve people's lives.


About the Job


The Events Platform \- Manager role is a part of the Go\-to\-Market Capabilities (GTMC), Customer Facing Capabilities (CFC), CRM \& Enablers team. The GTMC organization drives best\-in\-class capabilities and brings value and excellence in commercial operations. The GTMC organization is a key part of the modernization of Sanofi and allows all business operations efforts to be focused on Sanofi "Take the Lead" priorities across products, markets, and pipelines. It accomplishes these goals through realizing the efficiencies of removing silos that exist between our business units, avoiding the duplication and overlapping of resources, standardizing our processes and tools, operating with a One Sanofi approach to accelerate our key capabilities development, and fostering the entrepreneurial spirit by speeding up the decision\-making process.


This role serves as the technical authority for Events and Congresses platform operations within OneCRM US, supporting the strategic vision for event platform capabilities, data governance, and system evolution. This leader ensures system enhancements operate as intended and advises on scalable event platform solutions that support multi\-brand, multi\-market launch requirements, ensuring enterprise\-wide compliance, data integrity, and continuous platform transformation across all Promotional and Non\-Promotional event types (Speaker Meetings, Displays, Product Theaters, Scientific Education Programs, and Speaker Trainings etc.).


This position will work closely with CRM \& Enablers Team members in the US, US\-based stakeholders, Hyderabad HUB resources, contracted system enhancement resources, Sales, Marketing, Medical, Field Engagement Management, Business Operations, Compliance, other GTMC pillars, Veeva, and Sanofi Digital to support the end\-to\-end design, governance, and evolution of the Events and Congresses platform across the OneCRM US ecosystem. This leader serves as a strategic partner across the enterprise, supporting platform direction, data governance standards, User Acceptance testing and operational frameworks that underpin compliant, high\-performing event execution at scale.


Main Responsibilities

* Support the strategic vision and roadmap for Events Management platform capabilities across OneCRM US, ensuring alignment with enterprise Events \& Congress standards and business priorities
* Serve as the technical lead for Veeva Events and Congresses enhancement user acceptance testing and issue investigation/resolution, overseeing service ticket process and driving associated improvements to the process
* Identify and recommend scalable event platform solutions supporting multi\-brand Speaker Meetings, Displays, Product Theaters, Scientific Education Programs, and Speaker Trainings across multiple markets and business units
* Drive enterprise\-wide data discrepancy investigation and correction for Compliance and Transparency events data, establishing data quality standards and reconciliation frameworks for transparency, compliance, and data integrity across all event types and downstream systems
* Ensure accurate end\-to\-end event platform frameworks and processes — including topic management, speaker profiles, budgets, and nomination and content submission tools — that scale with organizational growth and platform evolution
* Mentor the events platform operations team, providing technical guidance, knowledge transfer, and career development support that elevates individual and team capability
* Influence technical decisions across requirements gathering, system enhancements, and UAT for major platform initiatives, ensuring solutions are scalable, compliant, and fit for enterprise purposes
* Contribute toshape of the long\-term roadmap for Events and Congresses platform evolution and integration with downstream systems, including iCare, transparency, FMV, GRF, and contracting
* Lead change management efforts for Service Ticket (ESM) enhancements and evolution, driving adoption and alignment across field teams, Field Engagement Management, and business stakeholders including the creation of knowledge based articles.
* Drive capability building across the broader CRM community through structured knowledge sharing, best practice development, and train\-the\-trainer programs
* Partner with Field Engagement Management, Sales, Marketing, Medical, Compliance, and Business Operations to influence event platform strategy and ensure the platform meets evolving business requirements
* Oversight of service/incident ticket process for events , establishing performance measurement frameworks and continuous improvement approaches that drive platform excellence
* Investigate and remediate escalated inquiries, applying technical expertise to resolve complex issues and prevent recurrence through systemic process improvements
* Drive cross\-functional collaboration across partner GTMC US teams, ensuring event platform strategies are integrated with broader CRM and Global Events and Congress initiatives and enterprise data standards
* Partner with internal and external vendor technical teams to ensure platform readiness


About our Team


The CRM \& Enablers Team is a part of the GTMC organization in the US. The CRM \& Enablers Team strives to support our business customer facing teams by delivering innovative CRM capabilities that are timely, reliable, accurate, and constantly improving. We focus on our customers — both brand teams and customer facing teams — to adapt our CRM platform and operational systems to meet their needs. Our efforts to streamline and maintain OneCRM US bring value and impact to the organization by reducing the manual workload on our customer facing teams, by providing accurate activity data back to reporting systems, and acting as the nexus of data flow to and from Sanofi data systems. This team operates as a strategic partner to the business, driving platform excellence and enabling compliant, high\-impact field engagement at enterprise scale.


About the Candidate


This candidate has a demonstrated track record of leading technical teams, influencing enterprise platform strategy, and designing scalable event platform solutions across multiple business units and product launches. They bring deep expertise in Veeva Events and Congresses, data governance, and compliance requirements — including PhRMA guidelines and transparency reporting — combined with the ability to translate complex technical platform requirements into enterprise\-wide operational frameworks. This leader has experience architecting event management solutions, driving process transformation, and building organizational capability at scale. They are skilled at influencing senior stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Medical, Compliance, and Field Engagement Management, navigating complex matrix environments, and shaping platform strategy across concurrent launch programs. Strong English communication skills and availability to engage with US stakeholders with significant operational hour overlap are essential.


Ideal Experience

* Bachelor's degree from an accredited four\-year college or university (Project Management Masters or MBA preferred)
* 7\+ years of progressive events platform and CRM operations experience with demonstrated leadership
* 7\+ years of experience in Biotechnology or Pharmaceuticals
* Proven track record of leading technical teams and driving strategic platform initiatives across enterprise\-scale programs
* Experience in solution architecture for event management platforms and CRM systems
* Advanced expertise in data governance, compliance requirements (PhRMA guidelines), and data integrity across events and transparency reporting
* Strong knowledge and experience with Veeva Events and Congresses, Agile processes, and event management systems
* Deep understanding of the events ecosystem including transparency, FMV, GRF, contracting, and field engagement integration
* A keen eye for improvement opportunities and the demonstrated ability to deliver on these opportunities
* Clear communication skills with the ability to explain not only the requirements and the "ask", but also the "why" with credibility
* Motivated, energetic, and a respected contributor who engages and elevates others
* Ability to change behaviors to evolve to the company's strategies and initiatives
* Experience working and thriving in a matrix environment
* Strong English communication skills with the ability to engage and align diverse stakeholders across geographies and functions

**About Us:**


At **Zithara.ai**, we are pioneering the next generation of **Customer Intelligence**. Our platform serves as the "North Star" for consumer brands, empowering them to unify disparate customer data, automate personalized omnichannel engagement, and deploy advanced AI Agents for sales, support, and marketing. Zithara.ai simplifies retention and accelerates revenue growth for high\-transaction, data\-rich industries across India and Australia.


**The Role:**


We are seeking a creative, data\-driven, and multi\-faceted **Social Media \& Omnichannel Marketing Executive** to join our growth marketing team in Hyderabad.


In this role, you won't just manage a single social page—you will own our brand’s digital footprint across organic social, paid advertising, and direct engagement channels like Email and WhatsApp. You will design, execute, and optimize cross\-channel campaigns aimed at capturing the attention of B2B retail business owners and C\-level executives in both India and Australia.


**Key Responsibilities:**


**1\. Social Media Marketing (Organic \& Paid Ads):**


* **Organic Strategy:** Plan, create, and schedule engaging content across LinkedIn, X (Twitter), YouTube, and Instagram that establishes Zithara.ai as a thought leader in Martech and AI.
* **Paid Campaigns:** Set up, monitor, and optimize paid ad campaigns on **LinkedIn Campaign Manager** and **Meta Ads Manager** to generate high\-quality demo requests and inbound leads.
* **A/B Testing:** Continuously test ad creatives, hooks, and audience segments (specifically targeting the Retail/E\-commerce landscape in IN and AU) to maximize ROAS and lower Cost Per Lead (CPL).

**2\. Omnichannel Execution (Email \& WhatsApp Marketing):**


* **Email Campaigns:** Build, segment, and execute targeted email marketing campaigns for inbound nurture tracks, cold outbound sequences, and monthly product newsletters.
* **WhatsApp Marketing:** Design and deploy conversational WhatsApp marketing workflows for event promotions (like trade shows), webinars, and direct lead re\-engagement.
* **Analytics Tracking:** Monitor key messaging metrics including open rates, click\-through rates (CTR), spam scores, and conversion rates to iterate on copy and targeting.

**3\. Content Creation \& Event Support:**


* **Copywriting:** Write compelling, persuasive copy for ad creatives, email subject lines, WhatsApp broadcasts, and long\-form social posts.
* **Collateral Coordination:** Collaborate with graphic designers or utilize tools like Canva to produce crisp, thumb\-stopping visual assets and video shorts.
* **Event Amplification:** Create buzz around major industry events and exhibitions (e.g., pre\-booking campaigns for retail trade shows) to drive foot traffic and booth appointments.

**Qualifications \& Requirements:**


* **Experience:** 2–4 years of proven marketing experience, ideally within a **B2B SaaS or Martech company**.
* **Paid Ads Mastery:** Hands\-on experience managing and scaling budgets on LinkedIn Ads and Meta Ads.
* **Tool Proficiency:** Experience using modern marketing tools (e.g., HubSpot, Mailchimp, Intercom, or native WhatsApp API setups). High proficiency with Canva or basic video editing apps is a major plus.
* **Exceptional Communication:** Stellar written and verbal English communication skills. You must be able to write sharp, professional copy that resonates with business leaders.
* **Data\-Driven Mindset:** You don't just post content; you actively track impressions, clicks, conversions, and revenue metrics to justify marketing spend.
* **Location \& Shift Awareness:** Based in Hyderabad. Willingness to occasionally align campaign scheduling and optimization tracking to match Australian business hours.

**What to Expect (Why Join Us):**


**"Drink Your Own Champagne"** \> You will be marketing a world\-class platform using the exact channels our platform automates. Your success stories will directly form the case studies we show our clients.


* **High\-Growth Environment:** Be part of an agile startup team where your ideas are implemented fast, and your impact is visible daily.
* **Advanced Tech Stack:** Work directly alongside AI engineers and SaaS growth experts, picking up cutting\-edge knowledge in AI agents and Customer Data Platforms (CDPs).
* **Competitive Compensation:** Attractive base salary with performance incentives tied directly to pipeline contribution and lead generation.

title: District Manager, Visakhapatnam
description:
At Zimmer Biomet, we believe in pushing the boundaries of innovation and driving our mission forward. As a global medical technology leader for nearly 100 years, a patient’s mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds.


As a Zimmer Biomet team member, you will share in our commitment to providing mobility and renewed life to people around the world. To support our talent team, we focus on development opportunities, robust employee resource groups (ERGs), a flexible working environment, location specific competitive total rewards, wellness incentives and a culture of recognition and performance awards. We are committed to creating an environment where every team member feels included, respected, empowered and recognised.

**Job Summary**
---------------

  

The primary objective of the District Manager (DM) (Recon) is to ensure achievement of sales objectives by providing excellent service and advice to current customers within an assigned geographic area, whilst also leveraging new and existing business with the aim of growing market share. Additionally, this role acts as a mentor for new Sales Colleagues and Clinical Support Representatives within a designated geographic area. Case support coordination, conversion of new business opportunities and some business analysis are required in this role.


The role is intended to provide a development pathway for experienced and successful Sales Personnel moving toward a career in sales management.


This responsibility involves a significant amount of time spent within the operating theatre environment and the incumbent must demonstrate an understanding of this environment and of the role as both a representative of Zimmer and a part of the operating theatre team. The DM is responsible for supporting current business in the Recon range of products, and to actively grow the business by gaining new accounts and increasing Market Share.


This responsibility involves a significant amount of time spent both enhancing current business and development of future business opportunities.


The DM (Recon) should possess a strong working knowledge of Zimmer and competitor products. As a pivotal role within the organization, the DM acts as a liaison point between the customer and the various internal departments (eg. Marketing, Finance, Operations) whose work impacts or is impacted by field activity.


As a conduit of information to and from the field, DM must also facilitate the flow of information regarding changes in the industry, customer environments, or competitor activity to others within the larger Zimmer organization.

**Principal Duties \& Responsibilities**
----------------------------------------


**Support and Review Current Business (40%)**

* Actively contact current and potential customers and attend to resulting customer requests.
* Conduct in\-servicing and workshops on products.
* Maintain good relationships with key accounts \& seek to continue leverage of existing business relationships.
* Responsibility of primary and secondary sales in the designated territory and Key accounts.
 **Targeting and Conversion of Business (50%)**

* Establish relationships with key decision makers currently using competitor products, within targeted geographical \& product areas.
* Present proposal to decision makers and convert customers to usage of Zimmer products.

 **Management Reporting(5%)**

* Completion of reports as required by NBM/GSM/SM (or others), including monthly reports \& expenses.
* Prepare ad\-hoc reports on an as\-required basis.
* To liaise with Distributors for effective customer service, order procurement for primary sales and realization of receivables from Distributors/Hospitals of the territory in co\-ordination with the Area/Regional Sales Manager and Finance Department.
 **Technical Learning and Skill Development (5%)**

* Attendance at relevant workshops and OT , where required, completion of learning assessment exercises.
* Study relevant clinical articles \& data to build knowledge base and provide relevant advice to customers \& staff.
**Expected Behaviour**

We respect you for your individual contributions and your diverse perspectives. We support your professional growth and provide you with opportunities to share in the company's success.

**ABOUT AMGEN**


Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the world’s toughest diseases, and make people’s lives easier, fuller and longer. We discover, develop, manufacture and deliver innovative medicines to help millions of patients. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains on the cutting\-edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond what’s known today.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

**Role Description** 

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world.


At Amgen, our shared mission to serve patients drives all that we do. It is key to our becoming one of the world’s leading biotechnology companies. We are global collaborators who achieve together, researching, manufacturing, and delivering products that reach over 10 million patients worldwide.

  

In this vital role, you will be responsible for managing the category strategy for Marketing Services, with a focus on **Advertising and Medical Communications**. As **Strategic Sourcing Manager, Marketing Advertising and Medical Communication.**


You will play a key role in developing and executing sourcing strategies that align with commercial, medical, and enterprise objectives. This includes leading sourcing initiatives, fostering cross\-functional collaboration, and enabling third\-party solutions that accelerate high\-quality commercial advertising, medical communications, and compliant omnichannel engagement.


In this role, you will:

* Build and manage strategic partnerships across Global Marketing, Global Medical, Medical Affairs, Commercial, Legal, Regulatory, and Procurement teams.
* Deliver value through cost optimization, supplier innovation, improved speed\-to\-market, and scalable content production capabilities.
* Lead sourcing events, supplier negotiations, and contract development for commercial advertising, medical communications, medical education, promotional and non\-promotional content, and content operations.
* Partner with stakeholders to optimize the end\-to\-end innovative content development, including modular content, digital asset management, AI\-enabled content creation, and content reuse strategies.
* Help ensure supplier compliance with quality, regulatory, legal, privacy, and medical governance requirements while driving operational excellence and continuous improvement.


Your work will help strengthen Amgen's content ecosystem by enabling compliant, high\-quality, and efficient primary (core) content development and medical communications that improve customer engagement, accelerate speed\-to\-market, and support the company's mission and future product growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Support the development of the continuously evolving category strategy for Creative (Core) Advertising and Medical Communications, ensuring alignment with commercial, medical, and enterprise priorities.
* Lead strategic sourcing initiatives with a focus on creative and medical agencies along with related eco\-system services.

* Partner cross\-functionally across Global Marketing, Global Medical, Medical Affairs, Legal, Regulatory, Commercial, and regional teams to ensure sourcing strategies support enterprise standards while enabling local market needs.
* Collaborate with external partners, peer networks, and industry organizations to stay ahead of evolving agency delivery models, AI\-enabled content development, medical communications trends, supplier capabilities, and industry best practices.
* Demonstrate expertise in drafting, reviewing, and negotiating complex commercial agreements that balance business value, quality, compliance, intellectual property protection, and enterprise procurement objectives.

**Win \- What we expect of you**

**We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The Strategic Sourcing Management professional we seek is a Manager with these qualifications:**


Basic Qualifications:

* Master’s degree and 6 years of business partnering, category management, strategic sourcing and/or related experience, OR
* Bachelor’s degree with **10\+ years of experience** in business partnering, category management, strategic sourcing, and/or related areas.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Strong financial, legal, and contractual acumen with experience negotiating complex commercial agreements for creative agency services, medical communications and related services.

* Exceptional ability to communicate complex category strategies, influence senior stakeholders, and lead change across Global Marketing, Medical, Procurement, Legal, Regulatory, and regional organizations.
* Familiarity with procurement technologies such as Ariba, Scout, and Sirion Labs, as well as ERP systems and analytics platforms used to support sourcing decisions, supplier performance, and process automation.

* Strong understanding of the regulatory and compliance environment governing pharmaceutical marketing and medical communications, including promotional content development.
* Knowledge of emerging trends in creative agency models, modular content, digital asset management, AI\-enabled content creation, and omnichannel content delivery, with the ability to translate market innovations into business value.
* Ability to articulate a forward\-looking business and category vision for Creative Agency model delivery and Medical Communications and build alignment around a strategic, value\-driven roadmap.

title: Customer Relationship Manager
description:
Position Overview

The **Customer Relationship Manager (CRM)** will be responsible for managing and enhancing Glow's overall client relationship journey, from initial enquiry to consultation, treatment, and post\-service engagement.

The role will have a strong focus on **client escalation management, lead tracking and conversion, online doctor consultations, review management, and quality auditing of Case Manager interactions**.

The CRM will work closely with Case Managers, Doctors, Centre Managers, Front Desk, and Operations teams to ensure every client receives a consistent, professional, and premium experience aligned with Glow's luxury brand standards.

Reporting To

COO

Key Responsibilities1\. Client Escalation Management

* Take ownership of client escalations and ensure concerns are addressed promptly and professionally.
* Act as a senior point of contact for complex, sensitive, or high\-value client concerns.
* Understand the root cause of complaints and coordinate with relevant teams to identify appropriate resolutions.
* Ensure timely service recovery while protecting the client relationship and Glow's brand experience.
* Maintain an escalation tracker and monitor cases until complete closure.
* Identify recurring complaints and recommend corrective and preventive actions to management.
* Follow up with clients after resolution to ensure satisfaction and rebuild trust where required.

2\. Client Enquiry \& Lead Conversion Management

* Monitor client enquiries received through various channels, including calls, WhatsApp, website enquiries, social media, digital campaigns, and other lead\-generation platforms.
* Maintain accurate data on incoming enquiries and their source.
* Track the complete journey from **Enquiry → Contacted → Consultation Booked → Consultation Completed → Treatment Conversion**.
* Analyse enquiry\-to\-consultation and consultation\-to\-treatment conversion ratios.
* Identify high\-performing and underperforming lead sources.
* Work with Case Managers to improve follow\-up quality and conversion rates.
* Identify lost, pending, dormant, and unresponsive leads and develop strategies for re\-engagement.
* Prepare regular conversion reports and provide actionable insights to management.

3\. Online Doctor Consultation Management

* Coordinate and schedule online consultations between clients and Glow's Doctors.
* Ensure clients are contacted and scheduled within the required turnaround time.
* Coordinate with Doctors and Case Managers to ensure availability and smooth consultation scheduling.
* Monitor scheduled, completed, cancelled, and missed online consultations.
* Follow up with clients who have not completed their scheduled consultations.
* Track conversion of online consultations into in\-clinic appointments and treatments.

4\. Review \& Reputation Management

* Monitor client reviews and feedback across relevant platforms, including Google and other approved channels.
* Track positive and negative feedback and identify recurring themes.
* Coordinate appropriate responses to client reviews in line with Glow's communication standards.
* Escalate negative or sensitive reviews to the appropriate management team for resolution.
* Analyse review trends to identify opportunities for improving client experience.

5\. Product \& Service Feedback Management

* Actively collect and consolidate **client feedback on products, treatments, services, and overall experience**.
* Identify recurring feedback regarding product efficacy, quality, pricing, availability, packaging, usage experience, or client preferences.
* Capture feedback received through Case Managers, Front Desk, Doctors, Therapists, reviews, WhatsApp, calls, and direct client interactions.
* Differentiate between **product\-related concerns, service\-related concerns, and client expectations** to identify the underlying issue.
* Maintain a structured **Product \& Service Feedback Tracker** and analyse trends periodically.
* Share relevant product feedback and recurring client concerns with **Management, Procurement, Operations, Doctors, Therapists, and other relevant teams**.
* Highlight products or services receiving consistently positive or negative feedback.
* Identify potential opportunities for introducing new products, services, packages, or improvements based on client needs and preferences.
* Ensure product\-related complaints are escalated promptly to the appropriate team for investigation and resolution.
* Track corrective actions and communicate relevant updates to clients where required.
* Provide management with **actionable client insights**, rather than simply reporting feedback.

6\. Quality Auditing of Case Manager Calls

* Conduct regular quality audits of Case Manager calls to clients.
* Evaluate calls against defined quality parameters and communication standards.
* Assess greeting, understanding of client requirements, product/service knowledge, communication, appointment conversion, follow\-up, objection handling, upselling/cross\-selling, accuracy, professionalism, and closure.
* Maintain individual Case Manager quality scores.
* Identify recurring gaps and provide structured feedback and coaching.
* Track improvement following feedback and training interventions.
* Escalate serious deviations, misinformation, or inappropriate communication to management.

7\. Client Follow\-up \& Relationship Management

* Monitor follow\-ups for prospective, existing, inactive, and high\-value clients.
* Ensure clients receive timely communication regarding consultations, appointments, treatments, packages, and relevant offers.
* Identify opportunities to re\-engage dormant clients.
* Support Case Managers in developing stronger client relationships and improving retention.
* Ensure important client interactions are documented accurately in the relevant CRM/system.

8\. Cross\-Functional Coordination

* Work closely with Case Managers, Centre Managers, Doctors, Front Desk, Marketing, Procurement, Operations, and other relevant teams.
* Coordinate resolution of client issues that require involvement from multiple departments.
* Ensure client feedback and insights are communicated to relevant stakeholders.
* Support management in implementing client experience and product/service improvement initiatives.
* Identify operational or product gaps that negatively impact the client journey and recommend solutions.

Reporting \& Analytics

The CRM will be responsible for maintaining and analysing key client experience and conversion data, including:

* Total client enquiries
* Enquiries by source
* Enquiry\-to\-contact ratio
* Contact\-to\-consultation conversion
* Consultation\-to\-treatment conversion
* Overall lead\-to\-client conversion
* Online consultation bookings
* Online consultation completion rate
* No\-show and cancellation rates
* Follow\-up completion
* Dormant lead reactivation
* Client escalation volume
* Escalation resolution time
* Review ratings and sentiment
* Case Manager call quality scores

The role should convert this data into **actionable insights**, rather than simply maintaining reports.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)Client Experience

* Client Satisfaction Score
* Escalation Resolution Rate
* Escalation Closure Time
* Repeat Complaint Rate
* Review Rating \& Sentiment

Lead Conversion

* Enquiry\-to\-Contact Ratio
* Contact\-to\-Consultation Conversion
* Consultation\-to\-Treatment Conversion
* Overall Lead Conversion Rate
* Dormant Lead Reactivation Rate

Online Consultations

* Online Consultation Booking Rate
* Consultation Completion Rate
* Online Consultation\-to\-Treatment Conversion

Case Manager Quality

* Call Quality Audit Score
* Follow\-up Compliance
* Conversion Performance
* Improvement After Coaching

Qualifications \& Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Healthcare Management, Hospitality, or a related field.
* **3–6 years of experience** in Customer Relationship Management, Client Experience, Customer Success, Inside Sales, Healthcare, Hospitality, Beauty, Wellness, or a premium service environment.
* Experience in managing client escalations and analysing conversion data is strongly preferred.
* Experience in call quality auditing, CRM systems, and lead management will be an advantage.

Required Skills \& Competencies

* Excellent verbal and written communication.
* Strong client relationship and escalation\-management skills.
* Strong analytical and data interpretation abilities.
* Good understanding of sales funnels and conversion metrics.
* Strong listening and call\-auditing skills.
* Ability to coach and provide constructive feedback.
* Excellent problem\-solving and decision\-making skills.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Ability to handle sensitive and high\-value client interactions with discretion.
* Strong Excel/Google Sheets and CRM proficiency.
* Highly organised with excellent follow\-up discipline.
* Professional, polished, and service\-oriented personality.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, target\-driven environment.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should be **highly client\-centric, analytical, commercially aware, and confident in handling difficult conversations**.

They should be someone who can look at a client enquiry not merely as a data point, but understand the entire journey—from the first enquiry and Case Manager call to the online consultation, treatment conversion, review, and long\-term relationship.

The individual should have the maturity to handle escalations independently, the analytical ability to identify conversion gaps, and the communication skills to coach Case Managers towards better client interactions and business outcomes.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means **fewer unresolved escalations, stronger client satisfaction, higher enquiry\-to\-client conversion, better online consultation utilization, improved reviews, and consistently high\-quality Case Manager interactions**.

The CRM will play a critical role in ensuring that every client interaction reflects Glow's standards of **luxury, professionalism, responsiveness, and exceptional care**.
